criteria.title: ML ingress policy is recorded
criteria.assertion: PSTF, docs, and UI classify ML browser import/deploy as rest_to_nostr_bridge.

criteria.title: HTTP receipt exposes Nostr correlation and publish acceptance semantics
criteria.assertion: ML REST routes return 202 receipts with request_event_id, request_kind, result_kind, read-model metadata, relay acceptance, and message text directing clients to Nostr completion events.

criteria.title: ML command publisher verifies relay acceptance
criteria.assertion: ML command publisher signs request events, preserves scoped tags/d-tags, and rejects zero accepted relay publishes after payload validation succeeds.
